entries.label: common_0230_rival_00a

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Here we are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Welcome
to
Uva Academy![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_00b

entries.text: This here’s the entrance hall![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_01

entries.text: You can sign up for all kinds of classes at the\ndesk behind me, and those halls off to the sides\r\nlead to all different parts of the school.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_02

entries.text: It’s totally big enough to let loose and battle in\nhere, but for some reason, they banned Pokémon\r\nbattling in the main entrance...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_03

entries.text: M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Miss Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_01

entries.text: How did you find your first school commute?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_02

entries.text: We had a blast!
entries.label: common_0230_select_01

entries.text: It was tough!
entries.label: common_0230_select_02

entries.text: I imagine Miss Nemona’s high spirits helped with\nthat. She’s a true asset to our fine academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_02a

entries.text: Oh dear, was it really? I suppose Miss Nemona\nmust have led you on quite the adventure...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_02b

entries.text: Not that I was expecting any less from our\nChampion-ranked student council president.\r\nReliable as ever, Miss Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_03

entries.text: Well, I know how to look after my friends!\nRight, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_04

entries.text: Oh! But speaking of which...we saw some of\nthose Team Star kids in town, Director![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_09

entries.text: You did?! Where?![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_07

entries.text: It was down the stairs from the front gates. They\nwere hassling this kid with an Eevee backpack...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_10

entries.text: That is quite the news. Are they still to be found\nout there?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_08

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Actually, [VAR 0x0100(0000)] flexed
on ’em
and ran
’em off.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_11

entries.text: You don’t say...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_09

entries.text:
Of course it’s a fine thing to try to help a fellow
student, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
But you might wish to show a bit of restraint as
you find your feet here at our academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_10

entries.text: And, Miss Nemona, do remember that the\nschool’s staff is here to resolve any such troubles.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_11

entries.text: Uh... Right! Yes sir, Director![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_12

entries.text: A child with an Eevee backpack, you say...\nI suppose that might have been Miss Penny.\r\nI’m relieved to hear she’s come to class, at least.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_12

entries.text:
Ah, and Miss Nemona? If you’d be so good, do
report to Mr. Jacq about this Team Star business.\c
As your homeroom teacher, he should be kept
apprised of all such goings-on.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_04

entries.text: You got it, sir![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_05

entries.text: Ah, but look at the time. You two had better\nhurry along—classes will be starting soon.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0230_head_teacher_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]We’re in class 1-A, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
C’mon,
I’ll
show
you
the way![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0230_rival_06
